corrections: Replaced old tab and section names in expandable explanations.
Shared in-page jump offsets prevent Follow the example from hiding its heading behind sticky filters.
Mobile What needs attention controls no longer reserve space for a header that has scrolled away.
Evidence-files link opens its actual section and enclosing methods panel.
Case-study footer and module-example labels match current tab names and example order.
Snapshot-section tracking uses the same offset reserved by navigation during sticky-control reveal.
Keyboard chart readouts remain visible through focus-induced scrolling; Escape and outside-click dismissal are retained.

preservation.disclosures: Synthetic data and scenario-prevalence limits, payment/acceptance distinction, restricted-review limits, scope dispositions and historical-record caveats retained.
preservation.publication: No commit, merge, push or deployment.

limits: Local rendered review at 1920, 1440, 1280, 768, 390 and 320 px; no physical-phone or human-user-study claim.
Linked local resources checked; unchanged external source pages are outside this presentation pass.
Historical assurance records were preserved, not rerun or recertified.
